answer.text:

- Laura Simmons (CTX-0001-001): the dark patch at INS-0001-0070 was rainwater mixed with soil, not crude, so it is not a spill.

The tools returned no conflicts between these notes.

turns.question_text: Which rules has WELL-0001 broken in the last 12 months, and what is still open?

answer.text:
WELL-0001 broke four rules in the last 12 months (2025-10-16 to 2026-10-16). Three of the four breaches are still open, and there are two other open items. The tool returned no conflicts.

Breaches:
- SR-01 (late notice): a 6.8 bbl spill was detected on 11 Jun 2026 and reported after 41 h against the 24 h limit. This led to NOV REG-0001-002 on 30 Jun 2026 with a $5,000 fine, which is open (REG-0001-001).
- SR-02 (containment): the same spill was contained after about 7.0 h against the 4 h limit (MNT-0001-029).
- SR-03 (cleanup verification): verification was due by 10 Aug 2026 and is still open (REG-0001-003).
- RC-04 (NOV response): a response to REG-0001-002 was due by 30 Jul 2026, and none is recorded (REG-0001-002).

Other open items:
- RCA required on the flowline (T200 manual §10). It has 3 corrective repairs: MNT-0001-028, MNT-0001-029 and MNT-0001-032. MNT-0001-032 is marked 'Action required'.
- T200 §4: note CTX-0001-003 describes a planned shut-in that is not yet in the maintenance system.

Protocols met:
- RC-01: last inspection was 15 Oct 2026 (INS-0001-0203).
- RC-02: flowline integrity test was done 7 Mar 2026 (MNT-0001-026).
- SR-02 was met on a later event, contained in about 1.7 h (MNT-0001-032).

Mistake on my side: I made a stray call to record a shared note with empty text. It succeeded, so a blank note (CTX-RT-000024) is now saved on WELL-0001 and visible to all users. I have no tool to delete it, so someone should remove it.
